title: No Spear Crafting
description: Datapack to disable spear crafting, but not the spear entirely
body:
**⚔️ Limit Spear Crafting**

A simple datapack that disables the default spear crafting recipe, giving you better control over progression and balance.

Spears can no longer be crafted normally ❌
Players must obtain them through exploration 🧭, loot 🎁, trading 💰, or custom systems.

Perfect for SMPs and RPG-style worlds.

---

**✨ Features**

* ❌ Disable default spear crafting
* 📈 Progression-based gameplay
* ⚡ Lightweight & server-side
* 🧩 Easy to install

---

**📦 Installation**

1. Place in your world's `datapacks` folder
2. Run `/reload` or restart 🔄


**💬 Support**
Found a bug 🐛 or have a suggestion 💡?
Leave a comment on Modrinth.

**📌 Notes**
Only removes the crafting recipe. Spears are still obtainable via other methods.
